review.assessment: This change modifies `due_dates()` to actively push any SLA due date that lands on a weekend or an office-closed day forward until it reaches an open business day. It imports `datetime` and the `closures` module, loads the closure registry once per call, and uses a while-loop to check both `day.weekday() >= 5` (catching Saturdays and Sundays) and `closures.closed(day)` (catching holidays/office shutdowns). The logic correctly handles consecutive closed days, stays within the requested scope of fixing the scheduling job failures, and does not touch `data/closures.json`.
